I like the typing one better — where I type a tag and press Enter, and each becomes a little chip I can remove. That's quick and doesn't box me into a fixed set of labels, and I can still make up a new one on the spot.

The one thing I'd want added to it: as I start typing, if I've used a label before, it should suggest it so I can pick the existing one. Otherwise I'll end up with "reading" one day and "read" the next and never keep them straight. The other panel showed me my existing labels but made creating a new one feel clunky. So: the typing interaction, but with it offering my already-used tags as I type. That's the combination I want.
